[attribute-pub-type]
=== `@pub-type` Type of Publication

Combined form of both the type and format of publication, combined. This attribute comes from an older version of JATS; Deprecated in NISO STS.

#### Usage/Remarks
##### Best Practice

This attribute, which is used only on the elements <<element-issn,`<issn>`>> and <<element-pub-date,`<pub-date>`>>, reflects an older version of JATS, which used specific precombined values. For NISO STS, Best Practice is: Use the <<element-release-date,`<release-date>`>> element instead of <<element-pub-date,`<pub-date>`>> to hold the date on which a standards document is published. The element <<element-pub-date,`<pub-date>`>> is being phased out. For <<element-issn,`<issn>`>>, the attributes <<attribute-publication-format,`@publication-format`>> and <<attribute-pub-type,`@pub-type`>> or <<attribute-specific-use,`@specific-use`>> can replace, in different attributes, the precombined values of the JATS <<attribute-pub-type,`@pub-type`>> attribute.

#### OPTIONAL on elements:  <<element-issn,`<issn>`>>, 
                  <<element-pub-date,`<pub-date>`>>

|===
| Value| Meaning

| Text, numbers, or special characters| Precombined type and format of the document. Best Practice is not to use this attribute.
                        See Remarks above.
| Restriction| This is an optional attribute; there is no default.
|===
